versions.changelog:
Initial release of the AI 电商图片创作团队 skill:

- Introduces a 3-person agent team (策划师, 执行师, 质检师) to cover the full workflow of e-commerce image creation: planning, execution, and quality control.
- Supports deep requirement analysis, creative briefing, AI image generation (即梦/Liblib), quality evaluation, and iterative optimization.
- Enables both automatic and manual collaboration modes for flexible workflow management.
- Provides configurable quality thresholds, team setup, and iteration limits.
- Outputs structured delivery results including images, creative briefings, and QA reports in JSON.
- Each team member is modular and can be used independently.
